Let me check if there's a pre-built binary or if I need to build it. Let me also check the build script:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh && echo "---" && find /workspace -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" -o -name "wasm-objdump" 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
